data.title: Fun With Everyday Things At Home
data.description: Let us look around the house and find the missing names together!

challenges.frameDisplay: We sleep in a ____ at night.
challenges.frameSpoken: We sleep in a... hmm... what?

challenges.frameDisplay: We wash our hands with water and ____.
challenges.frameSpoken: We wash our hands with water and... hmm... what?

challenges.frameDisplay: The ____ helps us see in the dark.
challenges.frameSpoken: The... hmm... what helps us see in the dark?

challenges.frameDisplay: I eat my yummy soup with a ____.
challenges.frameSpoken: I eat my yummy soup with a... hmm... what?

challenges.frameDisplay: The ____ tells us what time it is.
challenges.frameSpoken: The... hmm... what tells us what time it is?

data.gradeLevel: kindergarten students (ages 5-6) - Use clear language, relatable examples, foundational skills, and engaging visuals. Encourage exploration and basic problem-solving.
